authority.runtime: owner physical mobile, production 1.3; no new development build tested

guards: Exact ref and endpoint, no credentials/path/query/fragment/other port
Registered immutable operation and SHA-256 of SQL/scope/budgets
Explicit apply confirmation, no implicit writes in read or plan
Exact new CE-1 object allowlist, explicit row keys and induced-row bound
Zero external calls, queues, commercial quota or global changes
CE-100 complete healthy baseline and rollback/scope review before writes
Exclusive project coordinator required, no memory-only fallback
Daily UTC/work budgets reserved before transaction, retained on failure
Validate actual objects, keys, rows, bytes and SQL time before COMMIT
READ ONLY rollback, invalid result rollback, two consecutive SQL cancellations stop
Commit-unknown halts, no automatic retries or quota refunds
Immutable snapshots, expired job/target and clock/day-change rejection

limitations: Positive apply and rollback are adapter-double tests, not production transactions
Project-wide durable coordinator, real cancellation, transport binding and budget accounting require CE-103/105/106 integration
No active protection of legacy scripts, direct administrative SQL or all service-role callers
No RLS security certification, comparator quality measurement or G1 acceptance
Five-minute operational evidence freshness is not a commercial product/price TTL
